nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I don't really have time to talk right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't really have time to talk right now.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I was in the middle of an observation assignment, but right now I'm trying to end a very pointless conversation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was in the middle of an observation assignment, but right now I'm trying to end a very pointless conversation.

nodes.text: Ending annoying conversations? Clearly not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to be. It's part of my job.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: What are you doing? What is this? Did you get a gig with a Feed or something? Practicing being a reporter?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: All questions need to be quick unless they're progressing the course of an investigation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All questions need to be quick unless they're progressing the course of an investigation.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: It doesn't appear you'll take any kind of hint. What is it?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: That's not saying much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not saying much.

nodes.text: I can't disclose that information.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't disclose that information.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: As a member of law enforcement it wouldn't be right to endorse or condemn a piece of tech.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As a member of law enforcement it wouldn't be right to endorse or condemn a piece of tech.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: That's a person, not tech. There's a difference.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a person, not tech. There's a difference.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: You have a tenuous grasp on listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have a tenuous grasp on listening.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Should I interpret your silence as a welcomed end to this conversation?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should I interpret your silence as a welcomed end to this conversation?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: "Level Up!" ? Sure. If you want to upgrade your understanding of something. A ton of people I stop and search have the patches on them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Level Up!" ? Sure. If you want to upgrade your understanding of something. A ton of people I stop and search have the patches on them.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Do what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do what?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Oh, it's not random, it's targeted. Now, can you turn around and slowly put your hands on your head?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it's not random, it's targeted. Now, can you turn around and slowly put your hands on your head?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Then get the fuck out of here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then get the fuck out of here!
